transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, September 30. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Walking a tightrope: 5 hurdles facing Noel Tata and an unlisted Tata Sons. Noel Tata's plan for merging Tata companies seeks to maintain the private status of Tata Sons, avoiding any public listing. However, the Reserve Bank of India has already rejected previous requests to ease regulatory restrictions on Tata Sons. Additionally, potential dissent within the Tata Sons board may question the validity of this merger initiative, amplified by the Shapoorji Pallonji Group's counterarguments. Shiv Sena (UBT) neta shot dead outside party office in Thane. Pradeep Purnekar, a functionary of Shiv Sena (UBT), was shot outside his party office on Tuesday night. He sustained serious injuries and was taken to a private hospital where he was pronounced dead. This incident occurred in a residential area, raising concerns over law and order in the locality. Police are investigating the incident and reviewing CCTV footage to identify the assailants. Mark Zuckerberg, Priscilla Chan donate $4 million to save 600-year-old Hawaii fishpond. Mark Zuckerberg and Priscilla Chan have contributed $4 million for the preservation of Alakoko Fishpond in Hawaii. This historic site, which is over 600 years old, faced potential environmental degradation and development pressure. The donation helped acquire the property for long-term stewardship by the nonprofit Mālama Hulē'ia. Their initiative supports education about traditional Hawaiian aquaculture and native ecosystems. India warns US about cosying up to Pakistan, says could impact ties. EAM flags lack of empathy on terror concerns Nevada volunteers remove 120,125 pounds of waste from Truckee River watershed. On September 26, over 575 passionate volunteers dedicated their time to a significant cleanup effort in Nevada's Truckee River watershed. Their hard work resulted in the removal of an astounding 120,125 pounds of waste, which included both litter and invasive weeds. This collaborative initiative also focused on planting vegetation and enhancing storm drains, all aimed at safeguarding the local ecosystem. County denies Hilton Bluffs access after developer sued over roads. The Hilton Bluffs project in North Carolina is facing legal challenges regarding access road routes. Local residents have filed a lawsuit against Copper Builders, objecting to pathways that intrude on private land. Even after revised plans were submitted, local authorities deemed them unsafe, leading to continued construction delays. As both sides gear up for legal hearings, the situation underscores the intense demand for housing in the area. Budgam encounter: Army kills LeT terrorist after fierce gunfight in Yousmarg. OP KORAG, YousmargBased on specific intelligence input, a Joint Search Operation was launched by #IndianArmy, @JmuKmrPolice and @crpf_srinagar in general area Korag, Yousmarg.Vigilant troops observed suspicious activity and upon being challenged, terrorists opened fire,... Ted Turner bought 4,680-acre island to stop development; sold it for $4.9m. Ted Turner sold St Phillips Island to the South Carolina government for $4.9 million, much lower than its appraised value. The island will become part of South Carolina's state park system, focusing on ecosystem protection. Public access will be limited, allowing for educational programs and eco-tourism opportunities. Turner initially acquired the island in 1979 to prevent commercial development and has maintained its natural state. World's largest underground lake hidden beneath desert: Where is it?. Dragon's Breath Cave, located in Namibia, is home to the planet's largest underground lake. Discovered by Roger Ellis in 1986, this unique geological formation showcases rare aquatic species. The cave's isolated ecosystem has led to the presence of unusual creatures, including the blind Golden Cave Catfish. To visit this remarkable lake, special permits are required due to its private property status. Government admits problem of exorbitant pricing of drugs in SC for first time. With Supreme Court toughening its stand against poor patients being forced to pay exorbitant prices for medicines, govt on Tuesday admitted that there was a problem and assured the court it would make efforts to address it. CISF jawan kills 4 colleagues at Kathua hydel plant. Four Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) personnel, including an assistant commandant, were killed on Tuesday after a colleague allegedly opened fire at a National Hydroelectric Power Corporation Ltd (NHPC) project in J and K's Kathua district, officials said.

transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Seva Bharti Loses Contract To Run MP's First Paid Old Age Home 'Sandhya Chaaya' In Bhopal. The Social Justice Department has terminated Seva Bharti's contract to operate 'Sandhya Chaaya', MP's first paid old age home in Bhopal, after the facility attracted barely half a dozen residents. Bhopal Lower Lake Pollution Case, MPPCB Assesses rupees 2.10 Crore Environmental Compensation Against BMC. The MPPCB has assessed rupees 2.10 crore in environmental compensation against Bhopal Municipal Corporation over untreated sewage entering the Lower Lake and submitted its report before the NGT. MBBS Doctors In MP Face rupees 50 Lakh Penalty For Violating Three-Year Service Bond After PNDT Training. MBBS graduates completing six-month PNDT training in Madhya Pradesh will face a rupees 50 lakh penalty for violating the mandatory three-year service bond. Indore's MGM Medical College Faces Fresh Ragging Complaint, NMC Seeks 24-Hour Report. A fresh ragging complaint by first-year MBBS students at MGM Medical College, Indore, has prompted the NMC's anti-ragging cell to seek a report within 24 hours. An Indore head constable was seriously injured after a knife-wielding man allegedly attacked him six to seven times near Imli Bazar on Tuesday. Indore Food Safety Officials Halt Operations At Romeo Lane Kitchen, Momos Unit Over Licence And Hygiene Issues. Indore Food Safety Administration halted food preparation at Romeo Lane's kitchen and Goswami Momos during inspections on Tuesday, citing licence and hygiene-related irregularities. rupees 11 Crore Matrimonial Fraud Racket Busted In Madhya Pradesh, 6 Arrested. New in-charges to arrive in Bhopal today: Biplab Deb, Rekha Verma to reach party office after meeting Solan. Indore Hosts MP State-Level Kaizen Competition, 18 Industry Teams Showcase Innovations. The 15th Madhya Pradesh State-Level Kaizen Competition brought together 18 industry teams at Brilliant Convention Centre in Indore on Tuesday. Amit Shah to Attend Cow Breeders' Conference in Bhopal. Tale of two states: 20 percent quota for Agniveers in MP, 10 percent in Maharashtra. Student's Own CM Helpline Complaint Uncovers Alleged Marksheet Tampering, DAVV Orders Probe. DAVV has launched an inquiry after a BA student allegedly submitted a tampered first-year marksheet and appeared for her second-year examination despite not clearing a supplementary subject. 2 days after Bhopal lawyer's death due to electrocution, cops book 'unidentified agency' for negligence. Alarm After Two tigers Found Dead In Madhya Pradesh. 5 day Elephant Festival and Rejuvenation Camp begins at Bandhavgarh Tiger Reserve, Madhya Pradesh. transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. 8th Pay Commission arrear calculator: Why Level 7 employees may lose rupees 3.32 lakh due to 8th CPC report implementation delay. Central government employees are eagerly anticipating the 8th Pay Commission's report, which is expected to be submitted by November 2025. Any delays may result in considerable financial setbacks for them, as salary revisions will take effect from January 1, 2026. It's important to note that employees will only receive arrears on their basic salary and not on their allowances. rupees 10 lakh to rupees 1 crore: When does hiring an investment adviser make financial sense? Here's what experts recommend. There is no fixed corpus at which investors need an investment adviser. Experts say rupees 25 lakh to rupees 50 lakh can be a practical range to consider professional advice, but financial complexity, tax planning, debt, family responsibilities and investment experience can matter more than wealth alone. Central govt employees' annual bonus: Can it be paid in first week of October? What experts say. Representatives of central government workers are demanding that the Productivity-Linked Bonus ceiling be lifted, asserting that the present threshold of rupees 7,000 is insufficient in light of increasing living expenses. Various groups are urging for a new ceiling of rupees 21,000 to be used for calculating bonuses. The government is expected to reveal its decisions on bonus allocations in early October, with protests anticipated over the current calculation approach. Life-cycle mutual funds versus DIY portfolio: Automate investing or manage it yourself for 30 years, what experts suggest. Life-cycle mutual funds automatically adjust their asset allocation as a goal approaches, while a DIY portfolio lets investors decide how to divide their money across equity, debt and gold or silver ETFs. Experts explain how the two approaches differ and which one you should choose. Homebuyer paid rupees 1.73 crore for a flat in Gurgaon, builder delayed project and alleged that he booked unit for commercial gain; he fought and won the money back with 12 percent interest. Mr Rajinder Singh booked a flat in Gurgaon and was promised possession within three years. After a decade of waiting, he sought legal action against the builder for non-delivery. The State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission ordered the builder to refund the amount paid along with interest. Additionally, compensation for mental distress and litigation costs was granted to Mr Singh. Bigger home, but at what cost? How cheaper suburban rent quietly eats into your money, precious time and peace of mind. Suburban homes may offer more space for less, but hidden costs like commuting can diminish savings. It's vital to evaluate total living expenses and time lost when considering relocation. J and K Old Pension Scheme: These employees can switch from NPS to OPS. The Jammu and Kashmir government is offering eligible employees a rare chance to transition from the National Pension System (NPS) to the Old Pension Scheme (OPS). This opportunity is available to those appointed to specific roles prior to December 2009, provided they joined on or after January 2010, with applications accepted until December 2026. To apply, employees must submit requests to a Drawing and Disbursing Officer. Top 5 hybrid mutual funds: Quant Multi Asset tops the 10-year return chart at 18 percent ; check which schemes lagged. Hybrid mutual funds span categories with different equity, debt and asset-allocation strategies. Over 10 years, returns have varied sharply across these categories. Here's a look at the funds that delivered the highest returns and those that were at the lower end of the list. Do homebuyers lose claim to interest on delayed flat once you accept possession? Here's what Allahabad HC ruling states. Accepting possession of a delayed flat does not bar a homebuyer from claiming interest, according to the Allahabad High Court, which added that RERA rules do not specify a limit period on such payment. Want SIFs in your portfolio? Should you invest directly or choose the new mutual fund PRIM route , experts explain. SIFs offer investors access to specialised strategies with a rupees 10 lakh minimum investment, while the new PRIM route allows professionally managed portfolios with a rupees 25 lakh minimum. Here's how direct SIF investing differs from PRIM and what investors should consider. EPF and EPS rules under new wage ceiling: Earning rupees 20,000 and not EPS member? Know how your employer's PF contribution will change from October 2026. Employees earning up to rupees 25,000 will see changes in their EPF contributions due to mandatory EPS membership. Employer contributions will now be split between EPF and EPS according to the new rules. NPS Vatsalya: Who can make gift contributions to a child's account? Explained. NPS Vatsalya allows parents to secure their child's financial future by opening an account for minors. Launched in September 2024, it is regulated by the PFRDA, requiring a minimum annual contribution of rupees 1,000. rupees 9.91 lakh income tax refund for senior citizen after proving that he mistakenly paid income tax on tax-free bonds; ITAT Delhi order explained. Mr Ajay Kumar Bakaya a senior citizen from Gurgaon faced a significant tax issue when he accidentally overpaid income tax on his tax-free bonds' exempt interest income. After discovering this error, he filed a rectification application, which was initially rejected. He filed a case in ITAT Delhi and won it on September 23, 2026. NPS for small traders: Is rupees 3,000 monthly pension after 60 enough for retirement? Experts highlight harsh reality. The National Pension Scheme (NPS) for Traders offers eligible shopkeepers and self-employed persons an assured rupees 3,000 monthly pension after 60. But with inflation and retirement expenses rising, is this enough? Mother wins property battle against son and daughter-in-law: Delhi HC orders them to vacate her house. The Delhi High Court ordered a son and his wife to vacate his parents' house after ownership documents proved that his mother was the sole owner of the house which his father purchased. The court emphasized that mere residence does not confer ownership rights. Paid off your personal loan? Why your credit score might not jump right away. Loan closure is not just about making the final payment. Borrowers should also complete the necessary documentation and ensure that the lender updates the account correctly. Bank holidays in October 2026: Gandhi Jayanti, Dussehra, Durga Puja, and more; check full list. In October 2026, Indian banks will observe several holidays coinciding with major festivals like Dussehra and Chath Puja. The Reserve Bank of India's holiday calendar outlines these closures, which vary by region due to local traditions. While physical branches might be closed, online banking services will still be operational, providing customers the convenience to manage their finances during the festive period. Gen Z now constitute 38 percent of investors , Here's why they choose capital markets, how India's wealth inclusion has evolved. Indians under 30 years of age, or Gen Zs, now constitute 38 percent of investors. A report explores how India's wealth inclusion has evolved and why the capital markets have gained popularity as a choice of investment. My NRI status changed. Will interest earned on my NRE FDs be taxable in India?. ET Wealth reader's query: I was an NRI until FY2024–25. After relocating to India, my residential status changed to 'resident' from FY2025–26. While I was an NRI, I invested in fixed deposits through my NRE account, and these deposits are due to mature in FY27. Will the interest earned on these NRE fixed deposits be taxable in India?
